about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice B): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Five-Spice Roast Duck Leg Rice Plates
recipes.summary: Crisp-skinned duck legs rubbed with five spice, served on rice with greens.
steps: Rub the duck with the salt, five spice and ginger and rest in the fridge.
Roast at 160°C for 90 minutes until the meat is tender.
Brush with soy sauce and honey and roast at 220°C for 15 minutes until the skin is crisp and mahogany.
Cook the rice until fluffy and steam the bok choy for 3 minutes until tender.
Serve the duck over rice with the greens.
notes: Food safety: duck legs must reach 75°C and be very tender. Plus 2 hours curing.

recipes.title: Wok Cashew Chicken with Crisp Capsicum
recipes.summary: Quick wok chicken with cashews and crisp capsicum in a savoury sauce.
steps: Toss the chicken in the cornflour and soy sauce.
Stir-fry the cashews in the oil until golden, about 1 minute, then remove.
Cook the chicken for 5 minutes until browned and cooked through, then add the onion, capsicum and garlic for 3 minutes until crisp-tender.
Add the oyster sauce and cashews, toss and serve over rice cooked until fluffy.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C throughout.

recipes.title: Battered Cauliflower in Tangy Pineapple Glaze
recipes.summary: Crisp battered cauliflower in a bright sweet and sour sauce.
steps: Whisk the cornflour and water into a thin batter and coat the cauliflower.
Fry in oil heated to 180°C in batches for 4 minutes until golden and crisp.
Simmer the sauce, vinegar, sugar, soy sauce, capsicum and pineapple for 5 minutes until glossy.
Toss the cauliflower in the sauce just before serving.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Stir-Fried Beef and Gai Lan in Oyster Sauce
recipes.summary: Silky beef with crisp gai lan and a glossy oyster sauce.
steps: Toss the beef with the cornflour and soy sauce.
Stir-fry the beef in the oil in batches for 2 minutes until just browned.
Add the garlic, ginger and gai lan with a splash of water for 3 minutes until tender-crisp.
Return the beef, add the oyster sauce and toss until glossy. Serve with rice.
notes: Food safety: sear beef until browned, at least 71°C.

recipes.title: Spring Onion Oil Noodles
recipes.summary: Noodles tossed in sizzling spring onion oil and soy.
steps: Boil the noodles for 4 minutes until tender, then drain.
Heat the oil with the spring onion over low heat for 8 minutes until the onion is crisp and golden.
Stir in the soy sauces and sugar and toss through the noodles until coated.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Walnut Date-Free Sticky Rice Cake
recipes.summary: Steamed sticky rice cake with walnuts and brown sugar, sliced and pan-fried.
steps: Mix the flour, water and sugar until smooth and fold in the walnut.
Steam in a lined tin for 35 minutes until firm and translucent.
Cool, slice and pan-fry in the oil for 3 minutes each side until crisp outside.
notes: Dessert. Plus 1 hour cooling. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Tofu Skin Vegetable Rolls
recipes.summary: Crisp pan-fried tofu skin rolls with mushrooms and carrot.
steps: Stir-fry the mushroom, carrot, tofu and sprouts with the soy sauce and sesame oil for 5 minutes until dry, then cool.
Roll the filling in the wrappers, sealing with water.
Shallow-fry in oil for 5 minutes, turning until golden and crisp.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Temaki Hand Roll Sushi Night
recipes.summary: Hand-rolled nori cones with sushi rice, cucumber, avocado and salmon.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and fold through the vinegar, sugar and a pinch of salt while warm; cool.
Halve the nori sheets with scissors and keep them dry.
Spread rice on one half, add salmon, avocado and cucumber, and roll into a cone.
Serve with soy sauce and wasabi.
notes: Food safety: smoked salmon is ready-to-eat; pregnant people should avoid it.

recipes.title: Saikoro Beef Rice with Garlic
recipes.summary: Garlic-seared diced beef steak over rice with soy butter.
steps: Cook the rice until tender.
Sear the beef in a very hot pan for 3 minutes until browned, adding the garlic for the last minute until golden.
Add the soy sauce, mirin and butter and toss for 1 minute until glossy.
Spoon over the rice and top with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: beef pieces should reach 63°C for medium or higher for well done.

recipes.title: Chilled Silken Tofu with Ginger Soy
recipes.summary: Cold silken tofu with a punchy ginger-soy dressing.
steps: Drain the tofu and slide onto a plate, chill until cold.
Mix the soy sauce, ginger and sesame oil.
Top with spring onion, bonito and sesame and spoon over the dressing.
notes: Gluten-free if tamari is used. Not vegetarian: bonito.

recipes.title: Anpan Soft Bread with Sweet Filling
recipes.summary: Soft buns baked with a sweet bean-free sweet potato filling.
steps: Boil the sweet potato for 12 minutes until soft, mash with the honey and cool.
Knead the flour, sugar, yeast, milk, butter and egg for 10 minutes into a smooth dough; rise until doubled.
Divide into 8, wrap each around a spoonful of filling and place on a tray.
Prove for 30 minutes, brush with egg, add sesame and bake at 180°C for 18 minutes until golden.
notes: Dessert. Plus 90 minutes rising. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Cabbage and Pork Gyoza Soup
recipes.summary: Pan-fried gyoza served in a clear ginger broth.
steps: Mix the pork, cabbage, ginger and soy sauce and fold into the wrappers.
Brown the gyoza in the oil for 2 minutes until golden underneath.
Pour in the stock, cover and simmer for 8 minutes until the filling is cooked through.
Top with spring onion and sesame oil.
notes: Food safety: pork mince must reach 75°C.

recipes.title: Strawberry-Free Sakura Rice Pudding
recipes.summary: Creamy baked rice pudding with vanilla and a hint of rose.
steps: Combine the rice, milk, sugar and butter in a baking dish.
Bake at 160°C for 45 minutes, stirring once, until creamy and soft.
Stir in the vanilla and rose water and serve warm.
notes: Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Seaweed Rice Balls with Pickled Plum-Free Filling
recipes.summary: Onigiri filled with tuna mayo and wrapped in nori.
steps: Cook the rice until tender and cool until warm.
Mix the tuna, mayonnaise and soy sauce.
Wet your hands, shape rice around a spoonful of filling into triangles.
Wrap with nori strips and sprinkle with sesame.
notes: Food safety: keep refrigerated and eat within a day; cool cooked rice quickly.

recipes.title: Double-Fried Gochujang Honey Wings
recipes.summary: Double-fried crunchy wings tossed in a sweet-spicy glaze.
steps: Toss the wings in the cornflour and salt.
Fry in oil at 160°C for 10 minutes, rest, then fry again at 190°C for 5 minutes until deep golden and crisp.
Simmer the gochujang, honey, soy and garlic for 3 minutes until syrupy.
Toss the wings in the glaze and sprinkle with sesame.
notes: Food safety: wings must reach 75°C throughout.

recipes.title: Egg and Cheese Gyeran-ppang Bread
recipes.summary: Savoury Korean egg bread baked with a whole egg on top.
steps: Mix the flour, milk, baking powder, sugar, 1 egg and butter into a batter.
Pour into greased muffin holes, crack an egg on top of each and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake at 190°C for 18 minutes until the egg is set and the bread golden.
notes: Food safety: bake until the whites are set and yolks firm. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Spicy Silken Tofu Pot with Cracked Egg
recipes.summary: Spicy soft tofu stew with mushrooms and a cracked egg.
steps: Fry the garlic and gochugaru in the sesame oil for 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the stock, soy sauce and mushrooms and simmer for 6 minutes.
Add the tofu in big spoonfuls and simmer for 4 minutes until hot.
Crack in the egg, cover and cook for 2 minutes until the white is set; top with spring onion.
notes: Food safety: egg white must be set.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato Noodle Salad with Peanut Dressing
recipes.summary: Glass noodles with sweet potato, carrot and a sesame peanut dressing.
steps: Boil the sweet potato for 8 minutes until tender, drain.
Boil the noodles for 6 minutes until clear and soft, rinse and drain.
Whisk the peanut butter, soy, vinegar and sesame oil into a dressing.
Toss with everything and sprinkle with sesame.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Kkwabaegi Twisted Doughnuts
recipes.summary: Fried twisted doughnuts dusted with cinnamon sugar.
steps: Knead the flour, yeast, milk, caster sugar, egg and a pinch of salt for 8 minutes until smooth; rise until doubled.
Divide into 8 ropes and twist each.
Fry in oil at 170°C for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Roll in the cinnamon sugar while hot.
notes: Dessert. Plus 1 hour rising. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Pad Krapow Egg Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Fiery holy basil pork with fried egg on rice.
steps: Cook the rice until fluffy.
Stir-fry the garlic and chilli in the oil for 30 seconds, then the pork for 5 minutes until browned and cooked through.
Add the oyster sauce, fish sauce and sugar and cook for 1 minute, then stir in the basil.
Fry the eggs until the whites are set and serve on top.
notes: Food safety: pork mince must reach 75°C.

recipes.title: Massaman Sweet Potato Curry
recipes.summary: Mild peanut-rich curry with sweet potato, potato and onion.
steps: Fry the paste for 2 minutes until fragrant, then add the milk and stock.
Add the potatoes, onion, tamarind and sugar and simmer for 22 minutes until tender.
Stir in the peanuts and serve over rice cooked until fluffy.
notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Grilled Pork Skewers with Sticky Rice
recipes.summary: Honey-glazed pork skewers served with sticky rice and sweet chilli.
steps: Mix the fish sauce, honey, garlic and crushed coriander seed and coat the pork.
Thread the pork onto skewers, leaving a little space between pieces.
Grill for 10 minutes, turning until charred and cooked through.
Steam the rice until tender and serve together with sweet chilli sauce.
notes: Food safety: pork must reach 70°C and the juices run clear. Plus 1 hour marinating.

recipes.title: Coconut Pancakes with Palm Sugar
recipes.summary: Soft coconut pancakes with a caramel drizzle.
steps: Whisk the flour, baking powder, milk, egg and half the sugar into a batter.
Cook spoonfuls in the oil for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Melt the remaining sugar with 2 tbsp water for 3 minutes until syrupy.
Drizzle the syrup over and scatter with coconut.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Yellow Curry Cauliflower Lunch Pots
recipes.summary: Mild turmeric curry with cauliflower and potato.
steps: Fry the onion, curry powder and paste for 3 minutes until fragrant.
Add the milk, stock, fish sauce, potato and cauliflower.
Simmer for 20 minutes until tender.
notes: Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Rice Noodle Salad with Peanut Lime Dressing
recipes.summary: Cold vermicelli salad with herbs, vegetables and chilli lime dressing.
steps: Soak the vermicelli in boiling water for 5 minutes until tender, rinse and drain.
Dissolve the sugar in the lime juice and fish sauce.
Toss everything together and top with peanuts.
notes: Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Egg-Stuffed Rice Paper Fritters
recipes.summary: Crisp rice paper pockets filled with egg and vermicelli.
steps: Soak the vermicelli until tender and mix with the eggs, spring onion and fish sauce.
Soften wrappers in water, fill with the mixture and fold into parcels.
Fry in oil for 3 minutes each side until golden, crisp and the egg is set.
notes: Food safety: eggs must be set through. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Vietnamese Chicken Congee
recipes.summary: Silky rice porridge with shredded chicken, ginger and herbs.
steps: Simmer the rice, water and ginger for 25 minutes, stirring until thick.
Add the chicken and cook for 15 minutes until cooked through, then shred and return.
Season with fish sauce and serve topped with herbs and lime.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

recipes.title: Turmeric Fish with Dill and Noodles
recipes.summary: Pan-fried turmeric fish served over rice vermicelli with dill.
steps: Coat the fish in the turmeric, 1 tbsp fish sauce and ginger for 15 minutes.
Fry in the oil for 4 minutes each side until golden and flaking.
Soak the vermicelli until tender and divide into bowls.
Top with fish, dill, spring onion, peanuts and the remaining fish sauce.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and flakes easily at 63°C. Plus 15 minutes marinating. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Bánh Chuối-Style Coconut Banana-Free Bread Pudding
recipes.summary: Warm coconut bread pudding with sultanas.
steps: Tear the bread into a dish and scatter with sultanas.
Whisk the milks, eggs, sugar and vanilla and pour over, then soak for 10 minutes.
Bake at 170°C for 30 minutes until set and golden.
notes: Dessert. Vegetarian. Food safety: bake until the custard is firm.

recipes.title: Gudeg-Style Jackfruit-Free Sweet Pumpkin Stew
recipes.summary: Sweet coconut-braised pumpkin with egg and tofu.
steps: Boil the eggs for 8 minutes, peel and set aside.
Simmer the pumpkin, milk, water, sugar, garlic, onion and bay for 20 minutes until the pumpkin is tender.
Add the tofu and eggs and cook for 8 minutes until the sauce thickens.
notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free. Food safety: boil eggs until firm.

recipes.title: Slow Coconut Beef Dry Curry
recipes.summary: Dry-style coconut beef braise with lemongrass and chilli.
steps: Toast the coconut in a dry pan for 3 minutes until brown and grind to a paste.
Blend the shallot, garlic, galangal and chilli to a paste and fry for 5 minutes.
Add the beef, coconut milk, lemongrass, lime leaf and sugar and simmer gently for 2 hours.
Cook uncovered for 30 minutes until the sauce is dry and the beef is dark and tender.
notes: Food safety: braise beef until very tender, above 71°C. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Corn Fritter Rice Bowls with Sambal
recipes.summary: Crisp corn fritters served over rice with fried egg and sambal.
steps: Mix the corn, flour, 1 egg and spring onion into a batter.
Fry spoonfuls in oil for 3 minutes each side until golden; keep warm.
Fry the 3 eggs until the whites are set.
Serve over rice cooked until fluffy with sambal.
notes: Food safety: eggs cooked until the whites are set. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Black Rice Pudding Jars
recipes.summary: Overnight black rice and coconut jars with palm sugar.
steps: Soak the rice overnight and drain.
Simmer with the water for 30 minutes until the grains are soft and the liquid thickens.
Stir in the sugar and chill with the milk poured over; top with mango.
notes: Plus overnight soaking. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Mee Goreng-Free Hawker Egg Noodles
recipes.summary: Wok-fried egg noodles with greens, egg and sweet soy.
steps: Stir-fry the garlic and sambal in the oil for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the noodles and bok choy for 3 minutes until hot and tender.
Push aside and scramble the eggs until set, then toss with kecap manis and sprouts.
notes: Food safety: eggs cooked firm. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Kuih Ketayap Pandan-Free Coconut Crepes
recipes.summary: Thin crepes rolled around sweet palm sugar coconut.
steps: Whisk the flour, milk, water, egg and a pinch of salt into a thin batter.
Simmer the coconut and sugar with 2 tbsp water for 5 minutes until sticky.
Cook thin crepes in a lightly oiled pan for 1 minute each side until set.
Fill with the coconut and roll up.
notes: Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Curry Laksa-Style Vegetable Noodle Soup
recipes.summary: Coconut laksa with tofu puffs and vermicelli.
steps: Fry the paste in a pot for 2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the stock and milk and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the tofu puffs and cook for 3 minutes until hot.
Soak the noodles until tender and ladle the soup over; top with sprouts, coriander and lime.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Coconut Rice Plates with Chilli Eggs and Peanuts
recipes.summary: Fragrant coconut rice with sambal egg, cucumber and peanuts.
steps: Cook the rice with the milk, water and salt, covered, for 15 minutes until absorbed.
Boil the eggs for 8 minutes and peel.
Warm the sambal and toss the eggs in it for 2 minutes until coated.
Serve with cucumber and peanuts.
notes: Food safety: boil eggs until firm. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Chicken Sinigang Sour Soup
recipes.summary: Tamarind-soured broth with chicken and greens.
steps: Simmer the chicken with the water, tomato and onion for 15 minutes.
Stir in the tamarind and daikon and cook for 10 minutes until the daikon is tender.
Add the beans and spinach and cook for 3 minutes; season with fish sauce.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

recipes.title: Garlic Longganisa-Style Sausage Patties
recipes.summary: Sweet-garlicky pork patties for breakfast with rice.
steps: Mix the pork with the garlic, sugar, soy, vinegar and pepper and form into 8 patties.
Fry in the oil for 5 minutes each side until browned and cooked through.
Serve the hot patties with steamed rice on the side.
notes: Food safety: pork patties must reach 75°C. Plus 1 hour marinating.

recipes.title: Coconut Macaroon Mounds
recipes.summary: Chewy coconut macaroons with a golden top.
steps: Mix the coconut, whisked egg whites, sugar, vanilla and salt.
Scoop heaped tablespoons onto a lined baking tray.
Bake at 170°C for 15 minutes until golden at the edges.
notes: Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Pancit Canton-Style Noodle Plates
recipes.summary: Stir-fried egg noodles with vegetables and chicken.
steps: Stir-fry the chicken in the oil for 5 minutes until cooked through, then add the garlic and vegetables for 3 minutes.
Add the stock, soy and oyster sauces and bring to a simmer until bubbling.
Add the noodles and toss for 4 minutes until the liquid is absorbed.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

recipes.title: Spiced Cauliflower Pakora with Mint Dip
recipes.summary: Crisp chickpea-batter cauliflower fritters.
steps: Whisk the flour, water, spices and salt into a thick batter.
Coat the cauliflower and fry in oil at 180°C for 5 minutes until golden and crisp.
Mix the yoghurt with the chutney and serve alongside.
notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Creamy Tomato Chicken Flatbread Wraps
recipes.summary: Creamy tomato butter chicken in warm flatbread with cucumber.
steps: Brown the chicken in the butter for 5 minutes, add the paste and spices for 1 minute.
Add the passata and simmer for 12 minutes until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce thickens.
Stir in the cream, then spoon into flatbreads with cucumber.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

recipes.title: Lemon Rice with Peanuts
recipes.summary: South Indian tempered lemon rice with curry leaves.
steps: Cook the rice until fluffy and spread to cool.
Fry the mustard seed, curry leaf, peanuts and chilli in the ghee for 2 minutes until the seeds pop.
Stir in the turmeric, lemon juice and rice until the colour is even.
notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free. Food safety: cool leftover rice quickly and refrigerate within 1 hour.

recipes.title: Chickpea Flour Omelette Wraps
recipes.summary: Vegan savoury pancakes with onion, tomato and coriander.
steps: Whisk the flour, water, turmeric and salt into a smooth batter and stir in the onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Cook half the batter in the oil for 3 minutes each side until golden and set.
Repeat with the remaining batter and serve the pancakes warm.
notes: Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Kheer Rice Pudding with Pistachio
recipes.summary: Slow-simmered cardamom rice pudding.
steps: Simmer the rice and milk with the cardamom for 35 minutes, stirring until thick and creamy.
Stir in the sugar and raisins and cook for 5 minutes.
Serve topped with pistachio.
notes: Dessert. Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Dhal Tadka Rice Bowls
recipes.summary: Yellow-style red lentil dhal with spiced garlic butter.
steps: Simmer the lentils with the water, turmeric and tomato for 22 minutes until soft.
Fry the garlic, cumin and chilli in the ghee for 2 minutes until golden and spoon over the dhal.
Cook the rice until fluffy and serve.
notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Coconut Prawn Curry with Curry Leaves
recipes.summary: Southern prawn curry in coconut milk.
steps: Fry the onion in the oil for 5 minutes until soft, add the garlic, ginger, curry leaf and turmeric for 1 minute.
Add the milk and tamarind and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 4 minutes until pink and opaque.
Serve over fluffy rice with extra coriander if you like.
notes: Food safety: prawns must be opaque and pink, at 63°C. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Pol Roti Coconut Flatbreads
recipes.summary: Simple coconut flatbreads cooked on a hot pan.
steps: Mix the flour, coconut, chilli, onion and salt, add water to a soft dough and rest for 10 minutes.
Divide and roll into 8 flat discs about 3mm thick.
Cook in a hot dry pan for 2 minutes each side until blistered and cooked through.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Cardamom Biscuits for Chai Time
recipes.summary: Crisp buttery biscuits flavoured with cardamom and cinnamon.
steps: Cream the butter and sugar until pale, mix in the yolk and spices.
Stir in the flour to a soft dough and roll out.
Cut into rounds and bake at 170°C for 14 minutes until golden at the edges.
notes: Dessert. Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Zanzibar-Style Tomato Coconut Fish Pot
recipes.summary: Mild coconut curry with white fish, tomato and lime.
steps: Fry the onion in a pot until soft, about 5 minutes, add the garlic and curry powder for 1 minute.
Add the tomato and milk and simmer for 8 minutes.
Add the fish and cook for 5 minutes until opaque and flaking.
Finish with lime and coriander and serve over fluffy rice.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and flakes easily, at 63°C. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Sukuma Wiki with Egg and Ugali-Style Polenta
recipes.summary: Garlicky braised greens with fried egg and polenta.
steps: Cook the polenta in the boiling water for 10 minutes, stirring until very thick.
Fry the onion in the oil for 4 minutes, add the tomato for 3 minutes and then the kale for 6 minutes until tender.
Fry the eggs until the whites are set and serve on the greens with polenta.
notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free. Food safety: cook the egg whites until set.

recipes.title: Chapati Wraps with Curried Potato and Peas
recipes.summary: Soft Kenyan-style flatbread wrapped around curried potato.
steps: Knead the flour, water, oil and salt into a soft dough; rest for 20 minutes.
Boil the potato for 12 minutes until tender, drain.
Fry the onion and curry powder for 4 minutes, add the potato and pea and mash lightly.
Roll the dough into discs and cook in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side until blistered.
Spoon the filling onto the chapati and wrap it up to serve.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Apricot Almond Chicken Drumstick Pot
recipes.summary: Gently spiced chicken with apricots and almonds.
steps: Brown the chicken in the butter for 6 minutes, remove.
Fry the onion and curry powder for 4 minutes until soft, add the stock and apricots and return the chicken.
Simmer covered for 25 minutes until cooked through; scatter with almonds.
Serve over fluffy rice with extra coriander if you like.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C.

recipes.title: Rooibos-Free Honey Rusks
recipes.summary: Hard twice-baked rusks for dunking in tea.
steps: Rub the butter into the flour, baking powder and sugar.
Mix in the egg, buttermilk and honey to a soft dough and press into a tin.
Bake at 180°C for 35 minutes until golden, cool and cut into fingers.
Dry in a 100°C oven for 60 minutes until hard and crisp.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Spiced Samoan Coconut Rice Pudding
recipes.summary: Baked coconut rice with cinnamon and vanilla.
steps: Rinse the rice under cold water until it runs clear.
Combine the rice, milk, water and sugar in a pot and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring until thick.
Stir in the vanilla and cinnamon and serve warm.
notes: Dessert. Vegan and gluten-free.

recipes.title: Hawaiian-Style Pineapple Chicken Skewers
recipes.summary: Teriyaki-pineapple chicken skewers, grilled until charred.
steps: Marinate the chicken in the teriyaki sauce and ginger.
Thread onto skewers with the pineapple and capsicum.
Grill for 12 minutes, turning until charred and cooked through.
Serve with rice cooked until fluffy.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C. Plus 30 minutes marinating.

recipes.title: Cassava Coconut Pancakes
recipes.summary: Gluten-free pancakes made with cassava flour and coconut milk.
steps: Whisk everything except the oil until smooth.
Cook spoonfuls in the oil for 3 minutes each side until golden.
Serve with extra maple syrup.
notes: Vegetarian and gluten-free.
